mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachments (uploader_id, owner_type, owner_id, type, file_name, file_url, content_type, size, status, created_at) VALUES (#{uploaderId}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{type}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{contentType}, #{size}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE attachments SET uploader_id = #{uploaderId}, owner_type = #{ownerType}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, type = #{type}, file_name = #{fileName}, file_url = #{fileUrl}, content_type = #{contentType}, size = #{size}, status = #{status}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id}
